newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - cloudy at first, then fine, max 22 C.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - cloudy at first, then fine, max 22 C.

text.p: It will be cloudy in the morning, fine and dry during the day with a maximum temperature of 20 C, the Royal Observatory said on Wednesday.
Winds will be moderate and from the north.
At 7 a.m. the temperature was 17 C and the relative humidity 63 percent.
Outlook for Thursday and Friday: dry and cool. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
